item.title: Clarksburg Police Department K9 to receive new body armor
item.description: Each vest made by the non-profit is valued at $1,800, weighs between 4 and 5 pounds and comes with a five-year warranty. Lobo's vest will also be embroidered with the sentiment "Gifted by Vested Interest in K9s and Survival Armor."

item.title: Petrina Bonamico, co-owner of Oliverio's, passes away
item.description: Bonamico graduated from Notre Dame High School in 1983, was a member of the All Saints Catholic Church in Bridgeport and worked at Oliverio's for 35 years.

item.title: Doddridge County Elementary raises funds for class through hot cocoa sale
item.description: Students not only served sweet treats but also marketed to the community about the sale weeks beforehand, cold calling local businesses and family members during class.

item.title: Kayli Kellogg signs first high school NIL deal in West Virginia
item.description: According to a release, Kellogg will serve as a community brand ambassador for Vision Homes. The partnership will include social media promotions, community engagement events, and local outreach initiatives.

item.title: West Virginia Council of Churches hosts Compassion Calls Us Day at State Capitol
item.description: This year especially, they're asking for compassion for immigrants, people incarcerated, families without clean drinking water and communities that would be affected by data centers.

item.title: Marion County BOE moving forward with search for new superintendent
item.description: The meeting comes in the wake of the board declining to renew Superintendent Dr. Donna Heston’s contract earlier this week and the subsequent public speculation on why Heston’s contract was not renewed.

item.title: 'Baylea's Law' unanimously passes in West Virginia House
item.description: House Bill 4712- or 'Baylea's Law'- unanimously passed in the West Virginia House of Delegates Thursday, Feb. 19 in a 95-0 vote, with five delegates absent.

item.title: Randolph County Sheriff's Office searching for victims shot with BB gun
item.description: According to a press release from the sheriff's office, deputies received reports of a vehicle driving around the Elkins area and shooting at people with a BB gun. These reports were received on Feb. 7 and Feb. 8.

item.title: Taqueria Lou Lou closing after eight years
item.description: Taqueria Lou Lou also announced that the week leading up to its closure will serve as a “sell-out week,” during which the restaurant plans to sell all remaining food inventory to avoid waste.

item.title: Morgantown man sentenced for illegal firearm possession
item.description: An empty firearm magazine was also discovered, and it was found that all three of the guns had been reported stolen in 2024. Jones was prohibited from owning firearms due to prior convictions.
